name: msvc-runtime
description: Microsoft C++ v14 x64 runtime prerequisite for explicitly enabled native OpenRGB

storage.rationale: System-managed runtime libraries; no private persistent state.

installHint: Explicit optional setup only: scenario-dependency-analyzer deps install system/msvc-runtime --scenario msvc-runtime --surface host-tool --apply. Uses Microsoft winget package and then verifies System32 x64 runtime ABI/version/signature. No DLL search-path fallback.
privilegeReason: The optional Microsoft runtime is installed and serviced by the native Windows package manager into System32; no service runs with this elevation.
